test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some L are M.

II. All G are M.

**Conclusion:**

I. No G is L.

II. No M is L.

III. Some M are G.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions I and III follows

solution:
Given Statements:

I. Some L are M.

II. All G are M.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9984acdc2ec67f97915cb741188d79f7fdb10f55da30f4eb14d951119401df54.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No G is L - False (Because, No definite relation given between G and L, so it can be possible only).

II. No M is L - False (Because, Some L are M).

III. Some M are G - True (Because, All G are M gives Some M are G).

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
